summary: ObjectGenome direct decoder boundary is not fail-closed plain-data: decodeMechanismPosition(mechanism, position) calls mechanismPositionIsValid(), which dereferences mechanism.kind and mechanism range fields before independently validating the supplied mechanism table. A caller can therefore pass a metatable-backed mechanism whose __index executes or throws during decode, even though ObjectGenome's documented validation boundary otherwise rejects metatables. Harden the shared decoder by validating the mechanism as canonical plain data before field access (preferably via a reusable mechanism inspector shared with genome validation), then add an adversarial __index tripwire regression. This is distinct from active #318 familyVersion bounds and #326/#277 mutable-state aliasing work.
evidence: src/shared/Objects/ObjectGenome.luau: decodeMechanismPosition() delegates to mechanismPositionIsValid(); that helper reads mechanism.kind and hinge/slider bounds without first establishing a metatable-free exact mechanism shape for the direct argument.
